text:
alex_k: Quick heads-up — our promptcache token-saved metric for model rwd-2b dropped ~35% for customer Acadia (EU-west) overnight. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/promptcache/ -> noticed in the per-customer rollup. Anyone seeing similar across other tenants?

maya_ops: I saw a small dip in the /summarize route but didn't dig in. Will slice by route + seq_len.

jun_wang: did we push any runtime changes recently? kernel selection or batching heuristics?

deploy-bot: Deployed runtime change c3f7a2 -> kernel-selection heuristics + dynamic-batch-tuner at 2026-03-16T23:12Z (canary -> prod).

alex_k: that timing matches. Could be a subtle effect on prefix cache keying or kv-cache warmup ordering. 

jun_wang: running quick prometheus rollup to compare token-saved vs tokens-requested by model/route/customer over last 24h

```
# quick prom query (not perfect but useful)
sum by (model, route, customer) (increase(prefix_cache_tokens_saved_total[24h]))
/
sum by (model, route, customer) (increase(tokens_requested_total[24h]))
```

jun_wang: early result — Acadia /summarize on rwd-2b: saved fraction fell from ~0.62 -> 0.40. Other customers mostly stable.

sarah_r: can we check keying entropy? maybe normalization change caused more unique keys -> lower hit-rate.

jun_wang: grabbed sample keys for Acadia /summarize (top 200 requests). Pattern: an extra trailing newline and timestamp suffix in a subset. Looks like client SDK started appending metadata: `--ts=...`.

alex_k: wow. so it's not kernel selection. it's key pollution. Did the SDK change get rolled?

maya_ops: we shipped SDK 1.12.3 yesterday with a small change to prompt builder that appends metadata for analytics. Rollout was gradual.

sarah_r: action items: 1) add normalization to cache keying to strip small metadata tokens 2) add dashboard panel showing token-saved delta attributable to new key variance 3) create alert when per-customer token-saved drops >20% vs baseline.

perf-bot: Perf profile summary for rwd-2b /summarize (sample window 23:00-02:00): no regressive kernel hotspots, KV cache hit-rate down from 61% -> 41% (consistent). Flamegraph: https://perf.redwood/snapshots/ab12

jun_wang: I'll push a short-lived fix to normalizer in runtime to strip `--ts=` fragments from prompt keys and run a canary.

alex_k: sounds good. also can we add a per-route token-saved per-1000-tokens panel? that made it easier to spot customer-level regressions in the past.

maya_ops: added to dashboard draft: `token_savings_per_1k_tokens{model,route,customer}` + 95th percentile heatmap by seq_len.

sarah_r: recommend sampling 1% of requests with full payload saved for offline diffing so platform can replay and confirm restored hit-rate.

jun_wang: timeline: canary fix -> measure 2h -> if hit-rate recovers rollback-sdk (if needed). I'll post canary TS here.

alex_k: thanks — if canary shows recovery we should notify Acadia support + follow up with SDK team to revert or change rollout. :thumbsup:

maya_ops: created alert rule draft `promptcache.customer.token_saving_drop` with threshold 20% below 7d baseline, window 1h. pinging oncall.

perf-bot: note: also watch token_savings scatter vs sequence length > 1024 — larger sequences benefit more from prefix cache so variance there skews aggregate.

alex_k: good call. logged doc: https://docs.redwood/internal/promptcache-observability (runbook + dashboard links).

jun_wang: canary deployed at 1729005578 — will report back at 1729005678.

sarah_r: remaining owners: jun (fix + canary), maya (dashboard + alert), alex (customer comms).
